- United Kingdom generated £133.1k revenue TW, representing 82.0% of total sales across all countries.
- EIRE achieved £16.5k revenue TW with 10.1% market share, supported by 11 orders and 11,157 units sold.
- Netherlands contributed £6.1k revenue TW with 3.7% share, driven by 4,244 units across an unspecified number of orders.
- Total revenue reached £162.3k TW compared to £159.0k LW, marking a 2.1% WoW increase.
- Germany revenue surged 596.0% WoW, the strongest growth rate among all countries, with 7 orders placed TW.
- EIRE revenue grew 395.9% WoW, significantly outpacing the total portfolio growth rate.
- Sweden revenue increased 309.4% WoW, demonstrating strong momentum in the Nordic market.
- Total units sold reached 104,343 TW across 326 orders, with United Kingdom accounting for 84,187 units.
